summary: A ground lookout cabin in the Kootenai National Forest near Libby, dating from the 1930s; gone, and no source describes the site today.

facts.era: 1930s per firelookout.com; no build year recorded
facts.status_note: Cabin gone; no source describes the site today.

evidence.supports: Kootenai National Forest, 15 miles ESE of Libby, Lincoln County, elevation 6,001 feet
evidence.quote: Kootenai National Forest 15 miles ESE of Libby Lincoln County, Montana Elevation 6001'

evidence.supports: page titled as a fire lookout cabin
Forest Fire Lookout Association list classes the site as ground type and marks it gone
separate Richards Peak in Sanders County, listed as standing; not this site

notes_for_editor: Only source for the 1930s date is firelookout.com ("1930s: cabin. Gone."), so no build year is recorded and events are omitted. Record kind ground matches the FFLA type and firelookout.com's cabin description. Do not conflate with Richards Peak in Sanders County (a standing NHLR-registered site). The libbymt.com Libby lookouts page failed with a certificate error and was not read. Two searches found nothing lookout-specific beyond these two pages.
